A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with 26 readable pages including Appendices A–L. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v3 reports original unlearning experiments across four language models and five MCQA datasets, capability controls, LoRA experiments, and a human annotation study (Sections 6–7 and appendices).

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental and human-study results, including Tables 1–3 and the supplementary analyses in the appendices.

M1.justification: The PFF framework and FUR procedure retain identical unlearning objectives, content-word targeting, parameter updates, controls, and faithfulness measurements. The LoRA variant is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use ARC-Challenge, OpenbookQA, Sports, StrategyQA, TruthfulQA, and MMLU capability checks. The human study retains the same dataset coverage and participant population.

E2.justification: The Add-mistake comparison in Table 2, Paraphrase results in Table 4, and CC-SHAP experiment in Appendix B are identical. No comparator is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: Both versions document identical models, zero-shot prompts, sample sizes, held-out controls, preprocessing, learning-rate selection, LoRA settings, and human annotation procedures (Sections 4–5 and Appendices C–J).

E4.justification: The learning-rate sensitivity analysis, LoRA experiments, reasoning-change assessments, efficacy–faithfulness correlations, step-level analyses, and plausibility study are retained without modification.

E5.justification: Correlation and p-value reporting in Section 6.2 and Figures 7, 9, and 10 is identical, as is runtime variability reporting in Appendix K. No seed, repeated-run, or uncertainty-reporting information changes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results, and qualitative findings match across the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 retains 39.6% for FUR and 16.2% for Add-mistake on ARC-Challenge with LLaMA-8B.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations for efficacy, specificity, faithfulness, and NPO+KL remain identical (Equations 1–9). No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion are identical. Claims about parametric faithfulness, FUR, the two faithfulness metrics, reasoning changes, and human plausibility remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Both versions retain identical interpretations and limitations, including imperfect unlearning, alternative reasoning paths, CoT/no-CoT agreement, parameter-access requirements, English MCQA coverage, and potential risks.

D1.justification: Implementation details, prompts, hyperparameters, hardware, runtime, costs, and code/data access statements are unchanged, including Appendices D–K. The arXiv version-link update does not alter research-resource access information.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, related-work discussion, and positioning against contextual faithfulness and other parameter-intervention approaches are identical.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv v3 dated 3 Nov 2025 to v4 dated 13 Dec 2025. This is a limited administrative text edit; all paper prose, headings, and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–11, Tables 1–11, captions, formatting, placement, and page layout are unchanged. Rendered pages match apart from the text of the first-page arXiv stamp.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, evidence, reproducibility information, limitations, and presentation are identical throughout both PDFs and their appendices. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
